notes: Telegram Channel > Queue: two new ways to post besides the AI-drafted queue. 1) 'Send now' - a new blue paper-airplane button on every pending/confirmed post sends it to the channel immediately instead of waiting for its scheduled time (up to a minute away on the automatic check). 2) 'New message' - a new button next to the filters opens a form to write your own message from scratch, with an optional image attached, and sends it right away. Either one failing (e.g. bot not configured yet) behaves exactly like any other failed post - it lands in the list with the error shown and its own Retry button. No database changes.
